authenticity_review: High-quality still life with strong lighting and composition. Key AI artifacts: (1) Structural fusion between two central trumpets where tubing and valves merge indistinctly — this is a severity-2 structural defect. (2) Sheet music contains gibberish text ('Trunget saadles') and nonsensical notation — severity-2 text artifact. (3) Minor texture smearing/repetition on wooden table surface — severity-1. These defects collectively reduce authenticity below perfect, but image remains well above average generation quality.

self_reflection_notes: Changes made: (1) Lowered authenticity_score from 3.8 to 3.7 — triggered by Checklist Item #5 (Harshness Bias review): I initially underweighted the compounding effect of TWO severity-2 artifacts (structural fusion + text gibberish). While each alone might justify -0.3, together they warrant -0.5 from baseline 4.2. The structural fusion is particularly damaging as it affects core object integrity, not just background detail. (2) Lowered tax_score for atoms 2 and 3 from 0.95 to 0.9 — triggered by Checklist Item #1 (Score-Reasoning Consistency): My reasoning explicitly cited 'structural fusion' as a defect, but 0.95 implied near-perfect conformance. 0.9 better reflects that the objects are recognizable but structurally flawed. (3) Verified all Router verdicts independently per Checklist Item #4: Confirmed candle count via detector + visual; confirmed trumpet count despite detector over-segmentation (6 boxes vs 4 actual); confirmed text gibberish via image_text_auditor output ('Trunget saadles'). Did NOT rubber-stamp Router's confidence=0.95 for atom 2 — adjusted based on visible fusion artifact. Final scores are LOWER than initial assessment due to proper weighting of compound severity-2 defects.
